clue.text: A reign meant, we hear, a call to account

indicators.note: we hear tells us the phrase before it is to be spoken, and its sound is what goes into the grid

parts.note: the three words said quickly run together into one formal legal word

explanation.surface: A remark that a monarch's rule had meaning turns into a demand for answers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' is the sound signal: say 'a reign meant' quickly and you have the word for formally charging someone in court.
explanation.definitionFit: Being brought before a court to answer charges is literally being called to account.

clue.text: Skill I'll use, on the eastern railway, to move heavy guns

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of persuasion
the contraction minus its apostrophe
E is the standard abbreviation for east or eastern

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of the know-how needed to shift big cannons along an eastern line.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery is the collective name for large mounted weapons such as cannons and howitzers.

clue.text: Reformed killers do new work

indicators.note: reformed means formed again, so the letters of the next word are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Murderers who have changed their ways take up honest jobs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reformed' reads as killers mending their ways, but it is telling you to rearrange the letters of 'killers'.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrain for a fresh kind of job is what learning new skills for employment means.

clue.text: Unimportant person turned up at home and went inside, into the unknown

indicators.note: these words tell us the pieces before them are placed within the word that follows

parts.note: taken as written
a cog in the machine is a minor, replaceable person

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: A nobody arrives home, goes indoors and vanishes into obscurity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses the home word, as a down clue reads upward; 'went inside' opens the last word between its second and third letters. 'the unknown' is an anonymous person.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone travelling under a hidden identity is anonymous, a stranger nobody recognises.

clue.text: Stocking material in many London warehouses

indicators.note: in signals that the answer lies within the run of letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: Hosiery fabric is held in numerous warehouses across the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: This synthetic fibre was famously used for women's stockings, which were even nicknamed after it.

clue.text: Guaranteed to be safe in goal

indicators.note: in places the word for safe inside the word for goal

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
sure means safe or certain, as in a sure bet

explanation.surface: A footballer is promised that the net is protected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'safe' and 'goal' sound like football, but give SURE and END.
explanation.definitionFit: To make certain of something is to secure or confirm it, so it is promised.

clue.text: Use some tools on Thursday to make a prong

indicators.note: some of tools means only part of the word is taken, its first three letters

explanation.surface: A handyman picks up a few implements on Thursday to make a spike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just places the Thursday letters after the part of 'tools'.
explanation.definitionFit: Each point of a fork or comb is called one of its teeth, a projecting prong.

clue.text: Sudden attack on international court by America

parts.note: US stands for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A surprise assault is launched on a world tribunal by the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attack' here is medical: a stroke or seizure, not a military strike.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine an ictus is a stroke or seizure that strikes suddenly.

clue.text: Attack by parasites enclosed on metal post

parts.note: in means enclosed or inside
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron, a metal
a post is a station, as in a guard's assigned position

explanation.surface: A fence post of iron enclosed something being eaten by bugs.
explanation.definitionFit: When lice or fleas overrun a host, that plague of pests is called an infestation.

clue.text: Horses step on the plant

parts.note: colts are young male horses
to foot it is to step or dance

explanation.surface: Galloping animals trample on some greenery.
explanation.walkthrough: COLTSFOOT is a yellow-flowered weed of the daisy family.
explanation.definitionFit: Coltsfoot is a wild flower with hoof-shaped leaves, a member of the daisy family.

clue.text: Narrates the truth

parts.note: a recounting that is wholly honest, put as a negative: whoever speaks avoids every falsehood

explanation.definitionFit: Recounting only facts means never uttering a falsehood, which is what the phrase describes.

clue.text: Wrapping up the paper work

definitions.meaning: enclosing something by bending a covering around it
the art of creasing paper, origami

explanation.definitionFit: Wrapping up is enfolding something; the paper work is origami, the craft of creasing sheets into shapes.

clue.text: Warn Hal about the whale

indicators.note: about signals the letters are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone cautions a man called Hal about a large sea creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The narwhal is an Arctic whale whose male grows a long spiral tusk.

clue.text: Prepare route for fish to follow

indicators.note: to follow puts the fish after the route piece

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a route through a town
an eel is a snakelike fish

explanation.surface: Getting ready a path for fish to swim along.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prepare' as in steel yourself, brace for something hard.
explanation.definitionFit: To steel oneself is to brace or ready oneself mentally for an ordeal.

clue.text: Fashionable police force at hospital department succeeded with conflicts

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police
ENT, ear nose and throat, is a hospital department
S is a genealogical abbreviation for succeeded

explanation.surface: Trendy detectives at the clinic win out in a series of skirmishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Incidents can mean clashes or minor hostile encounters, such as border skirmishes.

clue.text: Ace lancer creates demolition

indicators.note: creates signals that new matter is made from the letters of the preceding words

explanation.surface: An expert cavalryman wreaks destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Slum clearance is the knocking down of buildings to free the site.

clue.text: For variety, I scan USSR for a plant

indicators.note: for variety means the letters are mixed up to give something different

explanation.surface: Looking over the Soviet Union in search of a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcissus is the genus of flowers including daffodils and jonquils.

clue.text: Surprisingly, Tom types a particular straight line

indicators.note: surprisingly means the letters fall in an unexpected order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: To everyone's astonishment a man named Tom keys in a certain line.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry it is a line that a curve approaches ever closer without meeting.

clue.text: Classifying a zygote in secure government

indicators.note: in puts the zygote word inside the word for secure

parts.note: to pin is to fasten or secure
a fertilised egg is a zygote

explanation.surface: Labelling an embryo inside a stable administration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Classifying' as in pegging someone as a type.
explanation.definitionFit: To peg someone as a type is to categorise or label them.

clue.text: Give up during work

parts.note: for can mean during, as in for an hour
to go is to work or function, as in the engine will not go

explanation.surface: Someone quits in the middle of a job.
explanation.definitionFit: To do without or relinquish something is to forgo it.

clue.text: Readily split up some soldiers in one ship

indicators.note: in places the pieces for one and ship within the soldiers word

parts.note: a file is a line of soldiers one behind another
I is the Roman numeral one
SS is the prefix for steamship

explanation.surface: A unit of troops easily divides up while aboard a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: Atomic nuclei that are fissile can be split, as in nuclear fission.
explanation.definitionFit: Fissile describes material whose atoms or grain can easily be cleaved apart.

clue.text: Discernment can be noticed

definitions.meaning: visible, able to be seen, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Discernment is perception or understanding; anything visible and noticeable is within view.

clue.text: Fully satisfied even if income support was lacking

annotationWithheld.why: Fully satisfied even if income support was lacking: the parse seems to remove IS and IF (printed reversed, FI, with no indicator) from SATISFIED, so 'satisfied' is both definition and fodder
annotationWithheld.clue: Fully satisfied even if income support was lacking

clue.text: A test in Germany near Luxembourg

definitions.meaning: one who makes an attempt, a tester
a German city on the Moselle near the Luxembourg border

explanation.definitionFit: One who tests or attempts something is a tester; the other is the ancient city on the Moselle by the border.

clue.text: Composer from town in Italy

parts.note: Ross is a town, short for Ross-on-Wye in Herefordshire, England
taken as written
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: A musician originates from some Italian town.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests an Italian birthplace; the town is English Ross-on-Wye, often just called Ross.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino Rossini was an Italian composer of operas such as The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: Ingredients I turn into food

indicators.note: ingredients are things to be mixed, so the letters of the following words are combined anew

explanation.surface: A cook says the components become something to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ingredients' looks like part of the cooking scene but signals the letters of 'I turn into' are mixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutrition is nourishment, the sustenance taken in by eating.

clue.text: Alexander's battle to join the international space station of America

parts.note: US stands for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A Macedonian conqueror's fight links up with an orbiting craft.
explanation.walkthrough: Issus, 333 BC, was where Alexander the Great defeated Darius III of Persia.
explanation.definitionFit: Issus is the place in Anatolia where Alexander the Great routed the Persian army.

clue.text: Tail producers?

parts.note: read as people who raise creatures that wag a tail, or animals used to follow and tail suspects

explanation.definitionFit: Kennel owners raise puppies, animals with tails, so they literally produce tails.
